description: This file defines the AdminClient class responsible for communicating with an OFBiz server through network socket commands for status checks and shutdown requests.

classes.name: AdminClient
classes.description: Provides static methods to send commands to the OFBiz server, such as requesting server status and shutdown.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the current status of the OFBiz server.

methods.name: requestShutdown
methods.description: Sends a socket command to request the server to shut down.

methods.name: sendSocketCommand
methods.description: Handles the socket communication process to send a command and receive a response.
